model_annotation: The bar chart displays a comparison of various models across different categories. The models are represented by different colors: mBERT-L2 (light blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (light green), XLM-R2 (dark green), mBERT-B2 (light red), and XLM-B2 (dark red). Each bar has an error bar extending upwards, indicating the variability or uncertainty associated with the measurement. The bars within each group are not sorted in any particular order, and the categories on the horizontal axis are not explicitly labeled, making it difficult to determine the exact values or trends without closer inspection. Overall, the chart presents a complex comparison of the six models across multiple categories, with varying levels of performance and uncertainty.
